### What you will do

Download the lab files, then run `python hydration.py recipe.json` from the extracted folder. The script prints the true hydration of the recipe, counting the flour and water inside the starter.

### Predict first

Before running it, work the numbers by hand as in [hydration and dough strength](#/module/hearth-m02). Write your prediction beside the recipe.

### Compare

Compare the printed result with `expected.json` and with your prediction. If they differ, find the line where your reasoning left the recipe. The [dense-loaf guide](#/course/hearth/guides/hearth-guide-dense-loaf) shows how hydration fits into a wider diagnosis.
